notes: The October JSON has explicit Normal Goat Cardpool, OCG Goat Cardpool, Added Structure Decks and Extra Card Pool values.
All non-classic October entries were compared by normalized name against the Duelingbook classic Goat list. Only the two entries below already occur in that list.
These exceptions remove classic reprints from All Added Cards and their addition category; they remain in Complete Card Pool with the original JSON pool shown in card details.
Do not use printedinTCG as the historical OCG-exclusive cutoff: many OCG-era additions have since been printed in the TCG.
The October JSON contains 103 Extra Card Pool entries (89 unlimited, 5 limited, 9 semi-limited). The gallery follows the JSON without imposing the blog description of a 90-card maximum.
